Access.description:
The roles of the users. It needs the section `auth`.

The value of `role_field` (an enum field of the user entity) is the
role of a user. A user may call the public operations and open the
public pages of `auth`, and the operations and the pages of the role.
With `memberships`, a user also has a role in each record of a scope
(ADR 0048).
Access.title: Access

Api.description: A third-party API that an OpenAPI document describes (ADR 0019).
Api.title: Api

ApiCard.description: The content of a card of API data.
ApiCard.title: ApiCard

ApiCardsView.description: A grid of cards, one for each item of an API answer.
ApiCardsView.title: ApiCardsView

ApiColumn.description: A column of a table of API data.
ApiColumn.title: ApiColumn

ApiDetailHeader.description: The header of a detail view of API data.
ApiDetailHeader.title: ApiDetailHeader

ApiDetailSection.description: A card with properties of the answer.
ApiDetailSection.title: ApiDetailSection

ApiDetailView.description: An object of an API answer in sections.
ApiDetailView.title: ApiDetailView

ApiOperation.description: An operation of the document that the app calls. Its name is the operation ID.
ApiOperation.title: ApiOperation

ApiSearchFilter.description: A text search in properties of the loaded items.
ApiSearchFilter.title: ApiSearchFilter

ApiSecurity.description: The credential that the client sends with each request.
ApiSecurity.title: ApiSecurity

ApiSort.description: The sort order of the items of an API answer.
ApiSort.title: ApiSort

ApiTableView.description: A table of the items of an API answer.
ApiTableView.title: ApiTableView

App.description: The name and the description of the app.
App.title: App

AreaFilter.description: The records whose `point` field is in a box, for example the visible part of a map.
AreaFilter.title: AreaFilter

Auth.description:
The sign-in with a user name and a password (ADR 0011), or with providers (ADR 0020).

The users are the records of `user_entity`. Each app stores the
password hashes apart from the records. All pages and operations need
a signed-in user, except the public ones.
Auth.title: Auth

AvailableFilter.description:
The records without a related record whose time range overlaps the picked days (ADR 0047).

`rule` is a relation to many records and a `no_overlap` rule of their
entity, for example `bookings.no_double_booking`: the start and the end
of the rule give the range of a related record.
AvailableFilter.title: AvailableFilter

BadgeRef.description: A field that shows as a badge.
BadgeRef.title: BadgeRef

BadgeSet.description: A label, a color, and an icon for each value of an enum field.
BadgeSet.title: BadgeSet

BadgeValue.description: The look of one enum value.
BadgeValue.title: BadgeValue

BoardColumn.description: The look of a column of a board: one enum value.
BoardColumn.title: BoardColumn

BoardView.description: Cards in columns, one column for each value of an enum field.
BoardView.title: BoardView

BooleanFilter.description: A yes or no filter on a boolean field.
BooleanFilter.title: BooleanFilter

CalendarView.description: The records on a calendar, by a date or a date-time field, in a week or a month.
CalendarView.title: CalendarView

Card.description: The content of a card in a card list or a board.
Card.title: Card

ChartWidget.description: A chart of an aggregate for each group of records, or of the daily values of a stat.
ChartWidget.title: ChartWidget

CompareRule.description: A rule that compares two fields of the form.
CompareRule.title: CompareRule

Confirm.description: A question that the user must confirm before an action runs.
Confirm.title: Confirm

Content.description: The content region of a layout, where the page shows.
Content.title: Content

ContentOverride.description: Content keys that change on narrow screens.
ContentOverride.title: ContentOverride

Crud.description:
The parts that the CRUD shorthand of an entity asks for.

`crud: true` asks for all operations. `crud: [create, list]` asks for
some operations. The mapping form also asks for views and forms.
Crud.title: Crud

CustomAction.description: An action that hand-written code gives (a generation gap).
CustomAction.title: CustomAction

CustomRule.description: A rule that hand-written code checks (a generation gap).
CustomRule.title: CustomRule

CustomWidget.description: A widget that hand-written code gives (a generation gap).
CustomWidget.title: CustomWidget

DashboardPeriod.description:
The period of a dashboard: the user picks a range, and the widgets with a
`period_field` show the records of the range.
DashboardPeriod.title: DashboardPeriod

Defaults.description: Values that apply when a UI element does not set them.
Defaults.title: Defaults

DetailHeader.description: The header of a detail view.
DetailHeader.title: DetailHeader

DetailSection.description: A card with fields of the record, or a generation gap.
DetailSection.title: DetailSection

DetailTab.description: A tab of a detail view: sections, a list of related records, the change log, or a gap.
DetailTab.title: DetailTab

DetailView.description: One record in sections and tabs. The page gives the record.
DetailView.title: DetailView

EmailVerification.description:
The verification of the email address of a new user (ADR 0023).

After the sign-up, the app sends a message with a link to the address.
The user can sign in only after the user opens the link.
EmailVerification.title: EmailVerification

Entity.description: A kind of record that the app stores, for example a task.
Entity.title: Entity

EntityCompareRule.description:
A rule that compares two values of a record, for example `ends_at` after `starts_at`.

A value is a field, or a total of the lines of the record, for example
`sum(lines.debit)`: the apps check a rule with a total after they write
the lines (ADR 0034).
EntityCompareRule.title: EntityCompareRule

EntityOverlapRule.description: A rule that the time ranges of two records with the same scope do not overlap.
EntityOverlapRule.title: EntityOverlapRule

EntitySeed.description: The seed of an entity: its records, and the number of generated records.
EntitySeed.title: EntitySeed

EntityUniqueRule.description: A rule that no two records have the same values in a set of fields and relations.
EntityUniqueRule.title: EntityUniqueRule

Event.description:
A custom operation of the entity that runs after a change of a record.

The operation runs in the transaction of the change, after the change
is in the database. An error of the operation rolls back the change.
The short form is the name of the operation: `created: notify_owner`.
Event.title: Event

Field.description: A field of an entity, or a param of a custom operation.
Field.title: Field

FieldRules.description: Validation rules of a form field, in addition to the rules of the field type.
FieldRules.title: FieldRules

Footer.description: The optional footer region of a layout.
Footer.title: Footer

Form.description: A form that calls an operation on submit.
Form.title: Form

FormField.description: A field of a form: a field or a relation of the entity, or an operation parameter.
FormField.title: FormField

FormOnSuccess.description: What the app does after the submit succeeds.
FormOnSuccess.title: FormOnSuccess

FormSection.description: A group of form fields with a title.
FormSection.title: FormSection

Grid.description: A column grid. Forms, card lists, and dashboards use grids.
Grid.title: Grid

GridOverride.description: The columns and the gap of a grid on screens narrower than a breakpoint.
GridOverride.title: GridOverride

Guests.description:
The records of the guests: the visitors without a sign-in (ADR 0050).

A guest gets a guest token from the app, and owns the records that it
makes with the guest operations, for example the items of a cart. A
signed-in user can move the records of a guest token to itself: the
front ends do it at the sign-in and at the sign-up. Then the owner
relation of each record is the user.
Guests.title: Guests

History.description:
The change log of the records of an entity.

Each create, change, and delete of a record adds an entry with the
user, the time, and the old and the new values of the fields. A
restore gives the old values of an entry back. The short form is
`history: true`.
History.title: History

Job.description:
An operation that the apps run on a schedule, or at the time that a date field gives.

A job with an entity runs a custom operation of the entity on each
record that its filter selects. A job without an entity runs a
function that hand-written code gives (a generation gap).
Job.title: Job

Language.description: A language of the UI, with the translation of each text.
Language.title: Language

Layout.description: An app shell: a sidebar, a top bar, the content, and an optional footer.
Layout.title: Layout

LayoutOverride.description: The region keys of a layout on screens narrower than a breakpoint.
LayoutOverride.title: LayoutOverride

LengthRule.description: A minimum or a maximum number of characters.
LengthRule.title: LengthRule

ListWidget.description: A short list of records in a table or a card list.
ListWidget.title: ListWidget

Live.description:
The live updates of the records of an entity.

The apps send an event for each create, change, and delete of a record
to the users that may read the record, and the open views of the
entity show the change. The short form is `live: true`.
Live.title: Live

LoadingState.description: What a view shows while it loads its data.
LoadingState.title: LoadingState

MapView.description:
The records on a map, by a `point` field, with a list of the records in the visible area
(ADR 0046).
MapView.title: MapView

MembershipRole.description: A role of the memberships (ADR 0048): its operations on the records of its scopes.
MembershipRole.title: MembershipRole

Memberships.description:
The roles of the users in the records of a scope, for example a course (ADR 0048).

A record of the membership entity gives its user (`user`) a role
(`role_field`) in one record of the scope entity (`scope`). The role
gives operations on the records of the scope: the scope record, and
the records of the entities in `paths`. A user can have other roles
in other scope records.
Memberships.title: Memberships

Menu.description: A navigation menu. The items without a group show before the groups.
Menu.title: Menu

MenuGroup.description: A group of menu items with a label.
MenuGroup.title: MenuGroup

MenuItem.description: An item of a menu. It opens a page, and it can have one level of sub-items.
MenuItem.title: MenuItem

MenuSubItem.description: An item below a menu item.
MenuSubItem.title: MenuSubItem

Motion.description:
The motion of the UI: the animations of charts, dialogs, menus, and transitions.

`full` keeps all animations. `reduced` stops them for users who ask
their system for reduced motion. `none` stops them for all users.
Motion.title: Motion

NearFilter.description: The records whose `point` field is at most a distance from a point (ADR 0046).
NearFilter.title: NearFilter

Notification.description:
The notices of a change of a record: who gets a notice, and its text (ADR 0041).

The change is an event of the entity (`created`, or `changed` with
`fields`), or a transition of a workflow of the entity. Each user at
the end of a receiver path gets a notice, except the user that made
the change.
Notification.title: Notification

NumberRule.description: A minimum or a maximum value.
NumberRule.title: NumberRule

OnSuccess.description: What the app does after an action or a form succeeds.
OnSuccess.title: OnSuccess

Operation.description: An action that the app can do on an entity, or a query that returns a list (ADR 0045).
Operation.title: Operation

OperationAction.description: Run an operation, for example a delete.
OperationAction.title: OperationAction

Page.description: A screen of a front-end app.
Page.title: Page

PageArrangement.description:
Layout hints of a page: the order of its regions in a grid of columns.

The regions fill the grid in their order. Each region takes one cell,
and `content` takes a full row. A region that the list does not have
does not show, but each page shows its content.
PageArrangement.title: PageArrangement

PageContent.description: What a page shows in its layout: one view, form, or dashboard, or a gap.
PageContent.title: PageContent

PageMeta.description: The metadata of a page for search engines and link previews.
PageMeta.title: PageMeta

PasswordReset.description:
The reset of a forgotten password (ADR 0017): a message with a one-time link.

The definition does not know the mail service, so the delivery of the
message is a generation gap.
PasswordReset.title: PasswordReset

PatternRule.description: A regular expression that the value must match.
PatternRule.title: PatternRule

Provider.description:
An OpenID Connect provider for the sign-in (ADR 0020).

The app sends the user to the provider, and gets an ID token back: the
authorization code flow with PKCE. The claim `username_claim` of the
token gives the user name. The app signs in the user with this user
name, or with `create_users` makes a new user.
Provider.title: Provider

ProviderRoles.description:
The roles of the users from a claim of a provider, for example the groups of Entra ID.

At each sign-in, the app sets the role of the user to the first role of
`map` whose group is in the claim. Without a match, the user gets the
`default_role` of the provider, or the app refuses the sign-in.
ProviderRoles.title: ProviderRoles

ProviderSignOut.description:
The end of the session of the user at the provider, at the sign-out of the app.

The app sends the browser to the logout URL of the provider with the
client ID and the URL of the sign-in page of the app. The provider ends
its session, and sends the browser back to the sign-in page.
ProviderSignOut.title: ProviderSignOut

QueryCalendarView.description: The rows of a query on a calendar, by a date or a date-time field.
QueryCalendarView.title: QueryCalendarView

QueryCard.description: The content of a card of a row of a query.
QueryCard.title: QueryCard

QueryCardsView.description: A grid of cards, one for each row of a query, one page at a time.
QueryCardsView.title: QueryCardsView

QueryColumn.description: A column of a table of the rows of a query.
QueryColumn.title: QueryColumn

QueryFilter.description: A field of the view that gives the value of a param of the query (ADR 0045).
QueryFilter.title: QueryFilter

QueryTableView.description: A table of the rows of a query, one page at a time.
QueryTableView.title: QueryTableView

RecordRule.description:
A record rule: the role uses only some records of an entity (ADR 0018, ADR 0025).

The records of the rule belong to the user (`owner`), and have the
values of the conditions (`where`). A rule needs `owner`, `where`,
or both.
RecordRule.title: RecordRule

Relation.description: A relation from one entity to another entity.
Relation.title: Relation

Role.description: A role: the operations and the pages that its users may use (ADR 0012).
Role.title: Role

SearchFilter.description: A text search in one or more fields.
SearchFilter.title: SearchFilter

SecondFactor.description:
A second factor of the sign-in (ADR 0024): the codes of an authenticator app.

Each user with a password can turn it on. Then a sign-in needs the
password and a code, or a recovery code.
SecondFactor.title: SecondFactor

SeedRecord.description: A seed record: the values of its fields and relations, by name.
SeedRecord.title: SeedRecord

SelectFilter.description: A choice of enum values or related records.
SelectFilter.title: SelectFilter

Sequence.description: The numbers of a database sequence: a new record gets the next number.
Sequence.title: Sequence

Sidebar.description: The sidebar region of a layout.
Sidebar.title: Sidebar

SidebarOverride.description: Sidebar keys that change on narrow screens.
SidebarOverride.title: SidebarOverride

SignUp.description: The sign-up of new users (ADR 0016): the fields of the form, and the role of a new user.
SignUp.title: SignUp

StatWidget.description: A stat tile: a count or another aggregate of records.
StatWidget.title: StatWidget

State.description: What a view shows in a state: a title, a text, an icon, and an action.
State.title: State

States.description: The loading, empty, and error states of a view.
States.title: States

Storage.description:
The storage of the files of the file fields: a local folder, or an S3-compatible service.

Each key that ends with `_env` names the environment variable of a
setting. With the kind `s3`, the apps use the local folder while the
variable of the bucket has no value, for example on the machine of a
developer and in the tests.
Storage.title: Storage

Theme.description: The theme settings of the app.
Theme.title: Theme

Token.description: A design token: a named value, with an optional value for each mode.
Token.title: Token

TokenGroup.description: A group of tokens and groups. The keys that do not start with `$` are names.
TokenGroup.title: TokenGroup

Tokens.description: The design tokens of the app: one group for each kind of token.
Tokens.title: Tokens

Topbar.description: The top bar region of a layout.
Topbar.title: Topbar

TopbarOverride.description: Top bar keys that change on narrow screens.
TopbarOverride.title: TopbarOverride

Transition.description: An allowed change of state: from one of the `from` values to the `to` value.
Transition.title: Transition

Translations.description: The languages of the UI. The text of the definition is in the default language.
Translations.title: Translations

UI.description: The `ui` section: the design tokens and the UI elements of the app.
UI.title: UI

ViewResponsive.description: How a view shows on screens narrower than a breakpoint.
ViewResponsive.title: ViewResponsive

Webhook.description: An endpoint that another system sends events to, for example a payment service.
Webhook.title: Webhook

WebhookBody.description: The schema of the body: a component schema of an OpenAPI document.
WebhookBody.title: WebhookBody

WebhookEventId.description: Where the ID of the event is: a property of the JSON body, or a header.
WebhookEventId.title: WebhookEventId

WebhookSignature.description: How the app checks that a request comes from the sender: a signature with a secret.
WebhookSignature.title: WebhookSignature

Workflow.description:
A state machine on an enum field of an entity.

The apps reject a change of the field that no transition allows. A
change to the same value is not a transition.
Workflow.title: Workflow

description: An app definition for appgen, DSL version 0. See ADR 0002.
title: appgen app definition
